report.summary: 4 findings reviewed: 1 confirmed, 2 narrowed, 1 needs-evidence. Plan includes 3 items for cache-key fix, egress ambiguity, and Python imports gap.
risks: If screen_egress does not distinguish read/write, adding a guard may break legitimate reads.
If index.py already merges python_imports, the fix would be unnecessary but harmless.
todos: Fix cache key language omission in daedalus/structcore/cache.py
Inspect screen_egress implementation and clarify read/write policy in daedalus/council/publish.py
Trace index.py usage in daedalus/eval/__main__.py to confirm Python imports handling

items.title: Fix cache key to include language parameter in daedalus/structcore/cache.py
items.why_now: Confirmed finding: file_key omits 'language' from cache key, risking collisions for same-path same-content files in different languages. This is a correctness bug.

steps.do: Add 'language' parameter to file_key function and include it in the cache key computation
steps.verified_by: Run tests/test_structcore_parallel.py, check that cache key includes language

steps.do: Update all callers of file_key to pass the language argument
steps.verified_by: Run tests/test_structcore_parallel.py, verify no test failures

steps.do: Update docstring in file_key to accurately describe the cache key composition

items.assumption: The language parameter is available at all call sites; if not, we need to thread it through.

items.title: Clarify egress gate behavior on reads in daedalus/council/publish.py
items.why_now: Narrowed finding: screen_egress is called in read_pr_thread, but its docstring focuses on outgoing data. If it blocks reads incorrectly, legitimate PR reads could fail.

steps.do: Inspect screen_egress implementation in sensitivity.py (if exists) or search for its definition to determine if it distinguishes read/write
If screen_egress does not distinguish, add a read-only mode or document that reads are not subject to egress checks
steps.verified_by: Run tests/test_council_publish.py, ensure read_pr_thread still works

items.assumption: screen_egress exists and is defined in a file we can locate; if not, we need to trace its import.

items.title: Verify Python imports are merged in index.py via daedalus/eval/__main__.py
items.why_now: Narrowed finding: extract_imports returns [] for Python; if index.py does not merge python_imports, Python imports would be missing from the index.

steps.do: Open daedalus/eval/__main__.py and trace calls to index.py to see if python_imports is merged
If python_imports is not merged, modify index.py to call python_imports and merge results
steps.verified_by: Run tests/test_eval.py, verify Python imports appear in index

items.assumption: index.py is the module that builds the index and is called from eval/__main__.py; we assume python_imports exists in parse.py.
